scenario_title: Null dereference after a removed guard
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-05-20 14:06-18:56: api-gateway: 324 of 449 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-20 14:06 and 2026-05-20 18:56 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.529 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} removed a null/nil guard; requests for records without the optional field now crash the handler.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) drops the null check before dereferencing the field.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore the guard at {file}:{line}; add a test with the optional field missing.

rca.macro: Deploy v2.17.0 of compute-svc removed a null/nil guard; requests for records without the optional field now crash the handler.
rca.micro: compute/rpc/RMClient.java:71 (RMClient.allocate) drops the null check before dereferencing the field.
rca.remediation: Roll back compute-svc v2.17.0 -> v2.16.1; restore the guard at compute/rpc/RMClient.java:71; add a test with the optional field missing.

action_items: Add a regression test covering RMClient.allocate (compute/rpc/RMClient.java).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
